title: [VSC-7] JetBrains: shared accounts corpus for AccountPresentation
description:
Epic epic-aabc654d (VS Code works + plugin reuse), sliced by task-a3e414a3 (VSC-0). First wave: no dependencies, files disjoint from the other first-wave rows. JetBrains first: this row writes the held-out corpus that the VS Code accounts rows (VSC-13 presentation port, VSC-14 view, VSC-15 actions) must pass unchanged.

Context: Claude account rotation (docs/plans/2026-10-20-claude-account-rotation.md; daemon side packages/moe-daemon/src/server/accountMessages.ts) has a JetBrains Accounts tab (AccountsPanel.kt over AccountPresentation.kt) and no VS Code UI at all (MoeDaemonClient.ts drops ACCOUNTS_UPDATED with the comment "VS Code has no account UI").

Reuse decision (VSC-0): one client-neutral JSON corpus per shared presentation, executed by both test suites (CQ-I06b, moe-jetbrains/src/test/resources/client-verdicts.json; rule in the header of ClientVerdictCorpusTest.kt). Each new corpus gets its own file. Text is shared as MoeBundle keys plus args; each client resolves keys to its own strings, and the VS Code consumer test checks its English equals messages/MoeBundle.properties.

Objective: pin AccountPresentation's pure functions (moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/AccountPresentation.kt): rows(rotation, now, zone), chips(rotation, now, zone), actions(rotation, selectedId, connected) and isValidLabel(input).

Deliverable:
- new moe-jetbrains/src/test/resources/client-accounts.json: `{ "version": 1, "now": "<fixed ISO instant>", "zone": "UTC", "rows": [ { "id": "C01", "rotation": <ACCOUNTS_UPDATED payload as the daemon sends it, or null>, "selectedId": ..., "connected": true | false, "expectRows": [...], "expectChips": [...], "expectActions": {...} } ], "labels": [ { "input": "...", "valid": true | false } ] }`, every text written as `{ "key", "args" }`. At least 12 rotation rows (null rotation; empty; one and several accounts; each sign-in state; usage windows with and without a reset time; the account in use; switch percent; vmToken states; disconnected; selection at the top, middle and bottom for move up/down) and at least 8 label rows.
- new moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/AccountsCorpusTest.kt: parses `rotation` through the same MoeJson path MoeMessageDispatcher uses for ACCOUNTS_UPDATED, runs each function with the corpus' fixed now and zone, compares with the expectations, asserts unique `C[0-9]{2}` ids and that every key exists in MoeBundle.properties, and reports every failing id at once.
If a row exposes a JetBrains bug, fix AccountPresentation.kt here and name it in the summary.

Not in scope: VS Code files, AccountPresentationTest.kt (unchanged), AccountsPanel.kt, the daemon.

Verification (WSL has no JDK): take the `jetbrains-gradle` lease (mem:convention-jetbrains-gradle-lease); `git archive HEAD | tar -x -C /mnt/d/moe-scratch/<dir>`; overlay this task's files; run `cmd.exe /d /c 'set GRADLE_OPTS=-Xmx512m&& cd /d D:\moe-scratch\<dir>\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --rerun'` (mem:gotcha-jetbrains-snapshot-gradle-test); release the lease even on failure.
definitionOfDone: moe-jetbrains/src/test/resources/client-accounts.json exists with version 1, a fixed now and zone, at least 12 rotation rows with unique C[0-9]{2} ids and at least 8 label rows, covering every case listed in the description.
AccountsCorpusTest.kt parses each rotation through MoeJson and asserts rows, chips, actions and isValidLabel against the corpus with the fixed now and zone, reporting all failing ids at once.
AccountsCorpusTest.kt asserts every text key in the corpus exists in moe-jetbrains/src/main/resources/messages/MoeBundle.properties.
A scratch-copy mutant that enables move-up for the first account makes AccountsCorpusTest fail (mutant discarded afterwards).
The full JetBrains suite passes in a git-archive snapshot under the jetbrains-gradle lease: `gradlew.bat test --rerun` reports BUILD SUCCESSFUL, with the JUnit total in the summary.
The diff touches only the two new files, plus AccountPresentation.kt if a row exposed a JetBrains bug (named in the summary).

implementationPlan.note: Wrote client-accounts.json with Write/Edit. cmp-identical to the architect oracle: sha256 e08b58c803980b2474bad79bd427069ebed688fdbf18f90ba6a3ac5c6c1295fc, 36335 bytes, 15 rotation rows (C01..C15), 14 labels (L01..L14). Gotcha: the Write/Edit parameter layer turns a bare é / ü (printable) into raw UTF-8 (control-range \u0085/\u0000/\u001f/\u007f stay literal), so L07 first landed with raw bytes (8 bytes short, sha a084617c...). Fixed by writing a placeholder `\ZZZ` then Edit replace_all `\ZZZ` -> `\u`, then re-verified with cmp. Peers own the other 28 dirty paths; untouched.

Wrote AccountsCorpusTest.kt (~278 lines, 4 JUnit4 tests: well formed; rows/chips/actions via parseAccountRotation AND parseState which must agree, args compared as Int vs String; labels; bundle key set == 23 account presentation keys with args count == distinct placeholders). Failures are collected per id and asserted once per test. Compilation is verified in step 4's gradle runs (WSL has no JDK).

implementationPlan.description:
Fix the JetBrains label bug that L08 exposes, in moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/AccountPresentation.kt isValidLabel.
- Replace `label.none { it.isISOControl() }` with `label.none { it < ' ' || it == '\u007F' }`, the daemon's CONTROL_CHARS_RE /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/. The rename and add dialogs then stop refusing a C1 control (U+0080..U+009F) that the daemon accepts.
- Update its KDoc: it mirrors registry.ts normalizeLabel (trim, at most 64 UTF-16 chars, no U+0000..U+001F or U+007F). Kotlin's trim also strips U+001C..U+001F at the ends, where the daemon's JS trim does not; that is a known, unpinned divergence.
- Change nothing else. AccountPresentationTest's `labels follow the daemon rule` cases keep their verdicts.
Error handling: isValidLabel stays total and throws for no input.
Name the fix in the summary: "JetBrains bug fixed: isValidLabel refused C1 control characters the daemon accepts (corpus L08)".
implementationPlan.note: isValidLabel: `label.none { it.isISOControl() }` -> `label.none { it < ' ' || it == '\u007F' }` (daemon CONTROL_CHARS_RE), KDoc updated (normalizeLabel mirror, C1 accepted, known trim divergence). git diff shows only that hunk. JetBrains bug fixed: isValidLabel refused C1 control characters the daemon accepts (corpus L08).

implementationPlan.description:
Gate under the jetbrains-gradle lease in snapshots, never in the shared tree (mem:convention-jetbrains-gradle-lease, mem:gotcha-jetbrains-snapshot-gradle-test, mem:gotcha-jetbrains-gradle-from-wsl: from bash, single-quote the whole cmd string and pass --tests unquoted).
- Lease: moe.acquire_resource {resourceId:"jetbrains-gradle", taskId, workerId, note}. If it is busy, call moe.report_blocked {resourceId:"jetbrains-gradle"}. Hold it only around the gradle runs, and release it even on failure.
- Run everything from the repo root.
1) Red: build the snapshot as the checkRef does, but copy only the two new files and keep HEAD's AccountPresentation.kt. Run `cmd.exe /d /c 'set GRADLE_OPTS=-Xmx512m&& cd /d D:\moe-scratch\vsc7-gate\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --tests com.moe.toolwindow.AccountsCorpusTest --rerun'`. It must FAIL in the labels test, naming exactly L08, while the other three tests pass.
2) Green: copy the fixed AccountPresentation.kt into that snapshot and rerun. All 4 tests pass.
3) Mutant, in that snapshot copy only: `sed -i 's/selected && index > 0,/selected \&\& index >= 0,/' /mnt/d/moe-scratch/vsc7-gate/moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/AccountPresentation.kt`. The architect dry-ran it: one replacement; confirm with diff. The focused run must FAIL, naming C04, C06, C11 and C13 and no other row.
4) Run the checkRef verbatim (a clean snapshot with the fixed file, full suite). Confirm BUILD SUCCESSFUL and that :test executed. Then cmp the three copied files with the shared tree, and sum the JUnit totals from TEST-*.xml for the summary.
Error handling for a red run:
- A red row other than L08 before the fix means the oracle and the code disagree: re-derive it from AccountPresentation.kt.
- Change AccountPresentation.kt beyond step 3 only for another genuine bug, named in the summary.
- "Could not receive a message from the daemon" is mem:gotcha-jetbrains-gradle-client-oom: rerun.
- A failure tied to a peer's wip checkpoint follows mem:gotcha-snapshot-gate-peer-wip-checkpoint.
- Never stop Gradle daemons or kill processes by name.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: AccountPresentation's pure functions (rows, chips, actions over a rotation parsed by MoeJson, and isValidLabel) are pinned by a client-neutral corpus, moe-jetbrains/src/test/resources/client-accounts.json, with a fixed now and zone, replayed by AccountsCorpusTest through both MoeJson paths. VS Code's VSC-13/VSC-15 replay the same bytes. One JetBrains bug is fixed: isValidLabel stops refusing C1 control characters, which the daemon's label rule accepts.

AccountsCorpusTest asserts rows, chips, actions and isValidLabel for every row through parseAccountRotation and parseState (which must agree), reporting all failing ids at once.
Every corpus text key exists in MoeBundle.properties; the key set equals the 23 account presentation keys; args counts match the placeholders.
Red/green: HEAD's AccountPresentation fails exactly L08; the fixed file passes; the move-up-at-index-0 mutant fails C04, C06, C11 and C13.
The full JetBrains suite passes in the vsc7-gate snapshot under the jetbrains-gradle lease: BUILD SUCCESSFUL, with the JUnit total in the summary.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: The corpus is large (15 rotations, 14 labels, 36 KB), so the architect generated it with an independent Python oracle that mirrors MoeJson + AccountPresentation, and staged it with its generator in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/vsc7-architect. That avoids hand-typing errors while keeping the oracle independent of the Kotlin code under test. Labels: the daemon's normalizeLabel is the reference (the KDoc says so), so L08 pins C1 controls as valid and JetBrains is fixed. Rejected: pinning exotic edge whitespace (U+001C..U+001F, U+FEFF), where Kotlin and JS trim differ. Rejected: a 32-account row, which would bloat the corpus; AccountPresentationTest covers the limit. switchAtPercent is not an input of these four functions, so the 'switch percent' case is C14 (a lower threshold, with spent driven by the daemon's blockedUntil) plus the switchAt action flag in every row.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: AccountText.args is List<Any>: Ints for percents and counts, Strings for labels and times. AccountRow/AccountActions/AccountText are data classes, so equality is structural. ACCOUNTS_UPDATED and STATE_SNAPSHOT both call parseAccountRotation. The daemon sorts seats and sends label = id when unset. Rows ignore rotation.error; the daemon sends an empty account list with an error.
planningNotes.risks: Java's Instant.parse accepts the corpus's .000Z instants; ZoneId.of("UTC") formats the same as ZoneOffset.UTC. The corpus holds \u0085, \u0000, \u001f and \u007f escapes: never let an editor turn them into raw bytes, and confirm the sha256. Gson's JsonPrimitive number equality is lenient, so compare through the Int/String conversion, not raw JsonElements. Apply the mutant only to the snapshot copy. git archive HEAD carries peers' wip checkpoints (mem:gotcha-snapshot-gate-peer-wip-checkpoint).
